title: Semantic random-stream and coupling contract
runtimeDerivation: SHA-256 counter RNG addressed by (seed, executable reference-simulator scenario_id, stream_name, event_index, draw_index)
rootConsequence: A shared numeric seed is not a common-random-number claim when executable scenario IDs differ.

couplingLabels.exact_shared: Both arms use the same executable scenario ID, stream name, address indices, and consumption semantics.
couplingLabels.shared_prefix: Addresses are identical only while both arms remain on the common exposure/read path; terminal or path divergence ends the claim.
couplingLabels.scenario_paired_rng_unpaired: Immutable scenario components are paired, but runtime roots, stream names, or consumption semantics differ; only the declared treatment-specific marginal law is claimed.
couplingLabels.not_consumed: The stream is absent under the treatment contract.
couplingLabels.not_executable: The contrast is excluded by a preserved implementation boundary.

constructionStreams.name: future_runtime_seed_s07_v1
constructionStreams.consumption: one uint64 draw during S07 generation
constructionStreams.S08Rule: reuse exactly across every pairing block and arm derived from the input

constructionStreams.name: fault_profile_assignment_s08_v1
constructionStreams.consumption: one counter-addressed uint64 rank key per input
constructionStreams.S08Rule: select one of 12 outcome-blind structural class-by-exact-count profiles

constructionStreams.name: placement_uniform_exact_s06_v1|placement_clustered_exact_s06_v1|placement_boundary_exact_s06_v1|placement_median_rank_exact_s06_v1
constructionStreams.scope: selected fault map for one input
constructionStreams.S08Rule: share the resulting immutable map ID and identity set across valid arms; never couple unlike placement generators draw-by-draw

runtimeStreams.name: actor_activation
runtimeStreams.consumption: unbiased bounded sampling with replacement; rejection blocks are charged
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: same executable scenario ID and same uniform scheduler in both arms

runtimeStreams.name: scheduler_permutation_s04_v1
runtimeStreams.consumption: counter-addressed Fisher-Yates blocks at sweep start including rejection blocks
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: same executable scenario ID and same permutation scheduler in both arms

runtimeStreams.name: bubble_side
runtimeStreams.consumption: one draw at each globally eligible Bubble opportunity
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: same executable scenario ID and common eligible-opportunity path; otherwise shared_prefix only

runtimeStreams.name: conflict_priority
runtimeStreams.consumption: one draw per actual proposal in a batch wider than one
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: same executable scenario ID, synchronous scheduler, and batch opportunity addresses

runtimeStreams.name: action_failure_bernoulli_s05_v1
runtimeStreams.consumption: one uint64 draw per charged opportunity
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: same executable scenario ID and same Bernoulli contract; effects may differ after proposal eligibility

runtimeStreams.name: action_failure_transient_s05_v1
runtimeStreams.consumption: one uint64 draw per charged opportunity with contract-owned availability state
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: same executable scenario ID and same transient contract

runtimeStreams.name: sensing_value_error_s05_v1
runtimeStreams.consumption: one draw per authorized logical observation record
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: shared_prefix only when the two arms make the same read sequence

runtimeStreams.name: sensing_status_error_s05_v1
runtimeStreams.consumption: one draw per authorized other-cell observation record
runtimeStreams.exactCoupling: shared_prefix only when the two arms make the same other-cell read sequence

schedulerCrossFamilyRule.uniformVersusPermutation: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired because actor_activation and scheduler_permutation_s04_v1 have different stream names and consumption patterns
schedulerCrossFamilyRule.deterministicOrAdversarialVersusStochast: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired because one arm has no actor-selection stream
schedulerCrossFamilyRule.synchronousVersusSerial: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired because synchronous conflict_priority consumption and batch opportunity semantics are treatment-specific
schedulerCrossFamilyRule.sameFamilyAcrossArchitecture: exact_shared when the executable scenario ID is identical; otherwise scenario_paired_rng_unpaired

faultAndTerminationRule.normalVersusFaulted: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired because faulted cell content changes executable scenario ID
faultAndTerminationRule.passiveVersusStuck: same immutable fault map but scenario_paired_rng_unpaired because mobility labels change executable scenario ID
faultAndTerminationRule.continuation: shared_prefix through the first arm-specific stop when scenario ID, scheduler, and fault mode are equal
faultAndTerminationRule.retry: shared_prefix while common opportunities exist; natural reactivation, proposal path, and terminal divergence may end pathwise equality
faultAndTerminationRule.actionFailureProfileChanges: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired across none, Bernoulli, and transient profiles; do not substitute one stream for another
faultAndTerminationRule.sensingProfileChanges: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired across exact and noisy profiles; exact sensing consumes no error stream

prohibitions: do not relabel a shared numeric seed as exact coupling when scenario IDs differ
do not reuse actor_activation values as scheduler_permutation_s04_v1 draws
do not add or discard draws to force equal consumption
do not condition construction streams on outcomes
do not permit worker, process, or completion order to enter any address
